geeklist.title: Steph's Awesome Holiday Auction! ---- *Ends 12/7/25 LATE*
geeklist.description:
Here are some guidelines
1) Auction: The auction will end on December 7, 2025 sometime after 11 pm Central. At the time the auction closes, the highest bid wins for each item.
2) Bids: Bids should be made in at least $1 increments. Items have Starting Bid prices - SB, and I won't accept lower bids than the starting bid. [b]I will be willing to consider bundle offers. Please geekmail me any offer.[/b]
3) Trades: At this time, trades are unlikely, but my wishlist is basically up to date if you would like to propose an offer.
4) Shipping: Buyer pays shipping cost. I will provide boxes and packing. I will be shipping out from 37128 (Murfreesboro, TN). If you would like me to provide a shipping estimate, I would be happy to do that for you. US shipping only. Sorry to all my international friends.
5) Local Pickup: Available in or around Murfreesboro, TN, and the surrounding area.
6) Payment: Payment can be made to Paypal, Zelle, or cash for those picking up locally. Payment is expected within 3 days of the end of the auction. This can be flexible if you communicate with me your situation.
7) Games: From a smoke-free home.
8) Condition: The game condition will be provided in the description of each game. Each game has been inspected for condition.
My rating scale is as follows: Components: NIS - New in Shrink Like new - Generally Played Once or Unpunched-unplayed Very good - light wear, no effect on gameplay Good - Worn components, not likely to effect gameplay but could
9) Edition: The picture of the game is the edition I have. If you still would like clarification, feel free to reach out.
10) BGG 3%: All sales will go through the BGG Marketplace and BGG will receive their 3%
